before: A transaction walked the whole story part again after each content control or paragraph split between tracked edits, and after the first delete in a document with notes or comments.
after: A transaction keeps its revision id counter across ops that add no revision ids, and its delete gates read the working story part.
reason: The change affects how a local transaction finds free revision ids and existing nodes. It mints the same ids and writes the same document bytes, so shared operations, room data, and serialization stay unchanged.
